basicDetails.schemeName: Kotwar Cycle Evam Torch Sahayata Yojana

children.text: Applicant must be registered as an unorganized worker in any district of the state.
Applicant must be between the ages of 18 and 60.
Applicant should not have received a cycle or torch under the cycle assistance scheme implemented by the board or any other scheme implemented by other departments of the state government.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. Applicant must be registered as an unorganized worker in any district of the state.
1. Applicant must be between the ages of 18 and 60.
1. Applicant should not have received a cycle or torch under the cycle assistance scheme implemented by the board or any other scheme implemented by other departments of the state government.

children.text: 1. Financial Assistance of ₹ 3,000/- per person for bicycle or the rate fixed by CSIDC for bicycle which will be lower
2. Financial Assistance of ₹. 750/- per person for torch.

schemeContent.benefits_md:
> 1. Financial Assistance of ₹ 3,000/- per person for bicycle or the rate fixed by CSIDC for bicycle which will be lower 

> 2. Financial Assistance of ₹. 750/- per person for torch.
schemeContent.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Kotwar Cycle Evam Torch Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 10 September 2013.

children.text: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Kotwar Cycle Evam Torch Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 10 September 2013. The main objective of the scheme to empower unorganized worker by providing financial assistance of Cycle or Torch .

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme &quot;Kotwar Cycle Evam Torch Sahayata Yojana&quot; for unorganized worker on 10 September 2013. The main objective of the scheme to empower unorganized worker by providing financial assistance of Cycle or Torch .

children.text: Applicant should not be receiving the benefit of the scheme from any other parallel scheme of the state government.

schemeContent.exclusions_md: > Applicant should not be receiving the benefit of the scheme from any other parallel scheme of the state government.
